title: Remove the recurring local direct-skip compaction startup timeout
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text:
При старте сервиса локально вот такая ошибка. Логи лежат здесь - D:\My\Business\PolyMarket\src\PolyCopyTrader.Service\bin\Release\net10.0\logs

Почини, пожалуйста
Ок, тогда делай что нужно, чтобы сервис корректно запускался локально

scope.goal: Make the current local PolyCopyTrader.Service start and process its normal 3,195-strategy Paper workload without the reproduced 30-second strategy-run-retention advisory-lock timeout chain, while preserving existing direct Paper skip-compaction results and all Live-disabled boundaries.
inScope: Change only the production v1 DirectNewPaperSkipArchiveSql candidate filter in PostgresAppRepository.DirectSkipCompaction.cs: remove its redundant correlated input_rows self-join that compares every candidate with every other JSON row for duplicate run IDs and duplicate normalized strategy/market keys.

Keep EnsureUnambiguousDirectPaperSkipInput as the mandatory pre-database ambiguity gate for every production call to DirectNewPaperSkipArchiveSql, including identical InvalidOperationException behavior before persistence for duplicate run IDs or normalized strategy/market keys.

Preserve all existing eligibility predicates, business dependency blockers, tombstones, rollups, projection events, reconciliation queue behavior, transaction boundaries, advisory-lock ordering, command timeouts, batch size, direct-compaction invariants, Paper accounting, and strategy behavior.

Add a focused source-shape regression proving the production v1 SQL no longer contains the correlated other_input self-join while the C# uniqueness gate and its call precede the database path, and retain the existing ambiguous-input integration coverage.

Add or extend a PostgreSQL integration regression with one 2,000-run unique production-v1 batch to prove all logical IDs are returned, pure skipped runs are compacted exactly once, retry remains idempotent, and the operation completes below the existing 30-second command timeout on the isolated local test database.
Run focused tests, the complete relevant StrategyRunRetention PostgreSQL integration class, and a Release solution build with all disposable outputs under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.

Run one bounded verification using the newly built local Release binary against only 127.0.0.1:5432/polycopytrader, with Bot.EnableLiveTrading=false and zero active live_stakes strategies. Limit absolute process lifetime to 120 seconds and the interval after first healthy heartbeat to 90 seconds; require two advancing healthy heartbeats, zero service Error/Fatal events caused by strategy-run retention, zero 30-second advisory-lock cancellation, zero persistence retry, and zero Live orders, then stop only the exact process started by Codex.
Update the existing compact non-secret local startup audit report with exact UTC cutoffs, test evidence, runtime counts, lock/error evidence, and any failed acceptance check.
outOfScope: Any connection or change to Production 192.168.0.101, any remote database, deployment, publish, Production service action, or venue action.

Any schema migration, DDL, manual data repair, backup, restore, ANALYZE/VACUUM command, strategy/catalog/configuration change, batch-size change, timeout increase, worker disablement, or advisory-lock removal/reordering.
Changing the dormant compact-skip archive v2 SQL, enabling v2 product writes, generalizing the optimization to unrelated SQL, or refactoring the persistence architecture.
Changing strategy decisions, prices, stakes, Paper/live parity, Maker behavior, settlement/accounting rules, or creating/cancelling a Live order.
Leaving any verification service process or isolated test database running after verification.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact current branch and exact local database on 2026-08-23 Europe/Sofia; runtime and database evidence recorded in UTC; production v1 direct-skip archive path only.
scope.firstVerification: Before editing, recheck the exact production dispatch and every call to DirectNewPaperSkipArchiveSql, prove each call is preceded by EnsureUnambiguousDirectPaperSkipInput, capture the reproduced 2,000-row plans and quadratic join-pair counts, and verify no local service process remains.

requirements.text: Eliminate the verified quadratic duplicate scan from the production v1 direct Paper skip archive without changing accepted or rejected inputs.
requirements.sourceQuote: делай что нужно, чтобы сервис корректно запускался локально
acceptanceCriteria: DirectNewPaperSkipArchiveSql no longer scans input_rows as other_input or performs candidate-count-squared JSON key comparisons.

Every production caller still invokes EnsureUnambiguousDirectPaperSkipInput before entering the database path, and duplicate run IDs or normalized strategy/market keys still fail before persistence with the existing exception contract.
No other v1 archive predicate, write CTE, invariant, timeout, batch size, transaction, or advisory-lock behavior changes; dormant v2 SQL remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

verification.command: Run the focused source-shape and existing DirectCompaction_AmbiguousInputFailsBeforeAnyPersistence tests.
verification.expected: The quadratic production-v1 SQL fragment is absent, the C# gate remains in the exact call path, and all ambiguity cases still fail before persistence.

requirements.text: Prove the optimized production v1 archive preserves exact results and completes a 2,000-run batch below its existing timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: An isolated PostgreSQL integration test submits exactly 2,000 unique pure skipped runs through the production v1 repository dispatch and completes before the unchanged 30-second command timeout.

The test verifies 2,000 logical inserted IDs, zero retained raw runs for those pure skips, 2,000 tombstones, exact rollup total 2,000, exact projection-event coverage, and idempotent empty retry without duplicate accounting.
The complete relevant PostgreSQL integration class and Release solution build pass with zero new errors.

verification.command: Run the new 2,000-run integration regression, then the complete StrategyRunRetentionPostgresIntegrationTests class and Release solution build using marked D:\CodexTemp outputs.
verification.expected: Exact archive/accounting invariants pass and the 2,000-run production v1 call finishes below 30 seconds without changing the timeout.

requirements.text: Verify the newly built service handles the exact local Paper workload without the recurring retention-lock timeout chain or any Live activity.
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh read-only preflight proves exact local endpoint/build/configuration, one valid baseline row, zero running local service, zero active live_stakes strategies, zero Live orders, and zero ungranted locks.
The newly built Release process produces two advancing healthy Running/Live heartbeats with NULL last_error within both time limits and is then stopped by exact PID.

The exact service/PostgreSQL interval contains no strategy-run-retention Error/Fatal event, no 30-second advisory-lock cancellation, no persistence retry, and Live orders remain zero; ordinary local Paper/runtime deltas are counted and reported.
Any new failing mechanism stops verification and requires a revised contract instead of an unapproved adjacent fix.

verification.command: Run the newly built Release binary once against exact local PostgreSQL within the two approved timers, poll exact heartbeat and Live-order state, stop exact PID, inspect the bounded service/PostgreSQL log interval, and reconcile runtime counts.
verification.expected: Healthy advancing heartbeat, no recurring retention timeout/retry chain, zero Live orders, exact process stopped, and only measured ordinary local Paper/runtime writes.
